canonical_project: VDC CWL31 Mwyndy Cross data centre

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Rhondda Cynon Taf Planning & Development Committee report for application 25/0138/FUL recommends approval for a data centre building with electrical/mechanical plant, substation, access, landscaping and drainage on land east of A4119 at Mwyndy Cross. Public reporting says the RCT planning committee approved the application. Capacity not disclosed; building footprint stated as 2,140 sqm.
